tool.search_characters: Search character profiles in the project (name/brief/personality/relationship summary); supports searching by name and filtering by group
tool.check_foreshadowing: List unresolved foreshadowing in the project (content/status/planted location)
tool.get_prior_summary: Get the project's prior-text summary (last N chapters; same source data as the context injected when writing)
tool.audit_chapter: Run a consistency audit on a single chapter (word count + LLM drift + static consistency) and return findings
tool.count_words: Count the word count of mixed Chinese/English text (Markdown syntax stripped)
tool.save_draft: Save a chapter draft (does not modify the official chapter). After the agent finishes writing the prose, it must call this tool to save the draft; the draft only takes effect after user confirmation. Returns the draft id.
tool.create_character: Create a character setting in the project and write it to the settings library; returns the new character id; fails if an active character with the same name exists.
tool.create_world_setting: Create a worldbuilding entry in the project and write it to the settings library; returns the new entry id. You must first create the root worldbuilding entry (one project has exactly one root); creating a non-root entry requires parent_id; creating an entry with a category requires creating that category first; same-name siblings fail.
tool.create_outline: Create an outline entry in the project and write it to the settings library; returns the new outline id; fails if an active outline with the same name exists.
tool.update_character: Update a character setting in the project (partial update; fields not passed remain unchanged)
tool.update_world_setting: Update a worldbuilding entry in the project (partial update)
tool.update_outline: Update an outline entry in the project (partial update)
tool.list_maps: List maps in the project (can filter by root location / top-level only)
tool.create_map: Create a map in the project and write it to the settings library; returns the new map id; fails if an active map with the same name exists
tool.update_map: Update map metadata (partial update; does not replace the map)
tool.list_timeline_events: List timeline events in the project (can search by keyword / sort)
tool.create_timeline_event: Create a timeline event and write it to the settings library; returns the new event id
tool.create_foreshadowing: Create a foreshadowing and write it to the settings library; returns the new foreshadowing id; created as open
tool.update_foreshadowing: Update a foreshadowing (partial update; does not include status transitions)
tool.memory_list: List memory preferences in the project (can filter by category)
tool.memory_add: Add a memory preference and write it to the memory library; returns the new preference id
tool.generate: Generate chapter prose based on the chapter context (writes the chapter content)
tool.delete_character: Delete a character setting in the project (executed with session delete authorization; ask_once requires user confirmation)
tool.delete_world_setting: Delete a worldbuilding entry in the project (executed with session delete authorization; ask_once requires user confirmation)
tool.delete_outline: Delete an outline entry in the project (executed with session delete authorization; ask_once requires user confirmation)
tool.delete_map: Delete a map in the project (including cleanup of linked pins; executed with session delete authorization)
tool.delete_timeline_event: Delete a timeline event in the project (executed with session delete authorization; ask_once requires user confirmation)
tool.delete_foreshadowing: Delete a foreshadowing in the project (executed with session delete authorization; ask_once requires user confirmation)
tool.memory_remove: Delete a memory preference in the project (executed with session delete authorization; ask_once requires user confirmation)
tool.agent_run: Start one agent chain pipeline execution
tool.agent_call: Call a single agent to execute one task
